Shared signed distortion and one tone-map/output conversion, premultiplied black coverage, zero-at-quad edges and measured post-composite color spaces are useful contracts.
Mirrored bolts with GreaterDepth and y0 floor are a planar reflection approximation; validate ground mask/occluders and actual depth convention, not every surface.

water_findings: Refraction frame copies, mirror layer/camera clipping and solid/water pass ordering need an explicit acyclic render graph and screen-edge/offscreen fallbacks.
Sphere-trace steps require a conservative field/step contract; warped procedural fields are not automatically exact SDFs.
Parallel-transport tube frames need zero/antiparallel tangent and closed-loop handling. Cull invalid/near/behind projection before perspective division.
Shared terrain math/hash is not proof of visible mesh vs CPU cache/interpolation equality. Compare the collision query to actual rendered geometry and all shard corners.

Corner-in-hull overlap tests can miss edge/edge convex intersections; use or validate the project collision method. Original240Hz/contact/114of120/1.9mm are measured source settings/results, not current guarantees.
Crystal IOR1.57/RGB dispersion/gain and water highlight rules include art-directed approximations; do not claim spectral transport or energy conservation.
Keep separate resonance pulse start times and sum bounded active pulses. Reserve hero/rain ripple slots rather than allow one class to evict the other.
Best-of-six redraw timing and claimed Metal timer failures are contextual; retain all-frame CPU/GPU distributions, disjoint/availability and contention conditions when actually measuring.
